commands.name: q-pilot
commands.description: Test a UI change from a prompt, and run, record and accept saved user flows
commands.output:
q-pilot · mode: affected · no flow run yet · pending edits: 0
/q-pilot dashboard opens the Dashboard · /q-pilot flows lists the flows · /q-pilot help shows every command

tools.name: pilot_status
tools.description: The last real q-pilot run of this project: outcome per flow (pass, drift, app-bug, blocked, env), failed checks with actual values, age. Call it before saying the user flows work, and quote it.

tools.name: pilot_run
tools.description: Runs one browser task from the user's prompt, like jev-ultrafast: Jev picks every click and field, Playwright executes it, and the user can watch and pause it in a live inspector. Put every value Jev must type in fixtures. When Jev is stuck (a loop, a widget it cannot work, a CAPTCHA, a DONE nothing checks) it answers needs_help with the page, and the run waits for pilot_help. Checks are optional. Call it once per user prompt: put several searches or sites the prompt asks for in one goal, and when Jev is stuck answer with pilot_help instead of starting a new run. Start another run for the same prompt only when the first ended blocked or failed, or the user asks for more. To check UI you built or changed, use pilot_test instead.

tools.name: pilot_help
tools.description: Answers a pilot_run "needs_help" request while the run waits with its browser open: a few actions on the shown elements (by index), then observe (look again), resume (Jev goes on), done (every requirement is visibly met) or stop. With only a runId it waits for the run's next event.

tools.name: pilot_test
tools.description: Runs one UI test written from the user's prompt: Jev drives the browser, code grades your checks. Call it once with the spec; the checks are fixed before the run, so report red checks as they are and never change them to make it pass.
